title: Meaning Feudalism at the Discovery Layer: Shepherds, Raw Research Data, and the Allocation of Semantic Capital in OpenAI's Mathematics and Science Releases, Oct
sentence: The research pass places the paper in four conversations, each developed inside an existing section: the reward system of science (Merton, Hagstrom, Dasgupta and David, Strevens, Heesen), which explains why the loss of attribution is a loss of the incentive to share (§6.5); the invisible technician (Shapin) and the sociology of automated proof (Ochigame), for the operator (§6.5b); the techno-feudalism debate (Varoufakis, Durand, Morozov), against which the series' use of the feudal vocabulary is stated (§6.8); and the provenance and attribution literature in machine learning (the Data Provenance Initiative; influence functions), which bears on whether slushing is a fixed property of pipelines (§9.2).
